templates.text: எங்கள் கிராமத்தில் குடிநீர் விநியோகம் இல்லை {repeat} 5 நாட்களாக மக்கள் தவிக்கிறார்கள் {filler}.
templates.translation: No water supply in our village for 5 days, residents suffering.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: பிரதான சாலையில் உள்ள பெரிய பள்ளம் {repeat} இருசக்கர வாகன ஓட்டிகளுக்கு பெரும் ஆபத்தாக உள்ளது {filler}.
templates.translation: Large pothole on main road posing serious danger to two-wheeler riders.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: சாக்கடை நீர் தெருவில் பெருக்கெடுத்து ஓடுகிறது {repeat} கொசு தொல்லை தாங்க முடியவில்லை {filler}.
templates.translation: Sewage water overflowing on the street, unbearable mosquito menace.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: மின்மாற்றி பழுதடைந்ததால் 3 நாட்களாக மின்சாரம் இல்லை {repeat} பள்ளி குழந்தைகள் படிக்க முடியவில்லை {filler}.
templates.translation: Transformer fault, no electricity for 3 days, students unable to study.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: ஆரம்ப சுகாதார நிலையத்தில் மருத்துவர் இல்லை {repeat} கர்ப்பிணி பெண்கள் அவதிப்படுகின்றனர் {filler}.
templates.translation: No doctor at primary health centre, pregnant women facing distress.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: பள்ளி கட்டிட மேற்கூரை விரிசல் அடைந்துள்ளது {repeat} மழை பெய்தால் ஆபத்தாக மாறும் {filler}.
templates.translation: School building roof cracked, dangerous during rains.
templates.action: School infrastructure repair drive

templates.text: விவசாய பாசன வாய்க்காலில் அடைப்பு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது {repeat} பயிர்கள் காய்ந்து போகின்றன {filler}.
templates.translation: Agricultural irrigation canal is clogged, crops drying up.
templates.action: Irrigation channel clearance and drought relief

templates.text: இரவு நேரத்தில் தெருவிளக்குகள் எரியவில்லை {repeat} பெண்கள் நடந்து செல்ல அச்சப்படுகிறார்கள் {filler}.
templates.translation: Streetlights not working at night, women afraid to walk.
templates.action: Streetlight restoration and night patrol deployment

templates.text: हमारे गांव में पानी की भीषण समस्या है {repeat} पिछले एक हफ्ते से नल में पानी नहीं आया {filler}।
templates.translation: Severe water crisis in our village, no tap water for past week.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: मुख्य सड़क पर जानलेवा गड्ढे बन गए हैं {repeat} आए दिन दुर्घटनाएं हो रही हैं {filler}।
templates.translation: Fatal potholes on main road, frequent accidents occurring.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: कचरे का ढेर पिछले 10 दिनों से नहीं उठा {repeat} बदबू से जीना मुहाल हो गया है {filler}।
templates.translation: Garbage dump not cleared for 10 days, stench unbearable.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: ट्रांसफार्मर जल जाने से पूरे मोहल्ले में बिजली गुल है {repeat} 48 घंटे से अंधेरा है {filler}।
templates.translation: Transformer burnt, power outage across entire neighbourhood for 48 hours.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र पर दवाई और डॉक्टर उपलब्ध नहीं हैं {repeat} मरीज परेशान हैं {filler}।
templates.translation: Medicines and doctor unavailable at primary health centre, patients distressed.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: सरकारी स्कूल की दीवार गिर गई है {repeat} बच्चों की सुरक्षा को भारी खतरा है {filler}।
templates.translation: Government school boundary wall collapsed, high risk to children.
templates.action: School infrastructure repair drive

templates.text: नहर का पानी टेल तक नहीं पहुंच रहा {repeat} फसलें सूख रही हैं किसान परेशान हैं {filler}।
templates.translation: Canal water not reaching tail end, crops drying up, farmers in crisis.
templates.action: Irrigation channel clearance and drought relief

templates.text: शाम होते ही अंधेरे का फायदा उठाकर असामाजिक तत्व घूमते हैं {repeat} पुलिस गश्त बढ़ाई जाए {filler}।
templates.translation: Antisocial elements roam in the dark at night, police patrolling needed.
templates.action: Streetlight restoration and night patrol deployment

templates.text: मराठवाड्यात दुष्काळजन्य परिस्थिती असून पाण्याचे टँकर वेळेवर येत नाहीत {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: Drought situation in Marathwada, water tankers not arriving on time.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: रस्त्यावर मोठमोठे खड्डे पडले असून एस.टी. बस सेवा बंद पडली आहे {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: Huge potholes on road, state transport bus service halted.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: गटाराचे पाणी रस्त्यावर साचले असून डेंग्यूची साथ पसरत आहे {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: Drainage water accumulated on road, dengue outbreak spreading.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: शेतीसाठी दिवसा वीज उपलब्ध नाही {repeat} रात्री पिकांना पाणी देणे धोकादायक झाले आहे {filler}.
templates.translation: No daytime electricity for farming, watering crops at night is hazardous.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: ग्रामीण रुग्णालयात ऑक्सिजन सिलिंडर आणि रुग्णवाहिका उपलब्ध नाही {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: No oxygen cylinder or ambulance available at rural hospital.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: जिल्हा परिषद शाळेची इमारत जीर्ण झाली आहे {repeat} नवीन खोल्यांची गरज आहे {filler}.
templates.translation: Zilla Parishad school building in dilapidated state, new classrooms needed.
templates.action: School infrastructure repair drive

templates.text: পানীয় জলের পাইপ ফেটে নোংরা জল আসছে {repeat} এলাকায় ডায়রিয়ার প্রকোপ দেখা দিয়েছে {filler}।
templates.translation: Drinking water pipe burst mixing with sewer water, diarrhea outbreak.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: রাস্তা ভেঙে নদীগর্ভে চলে গেছে {repeat} যোগাযোগ সম্পূর্ণ বিচ্ছিন্ন {filler}।
templates.translation: Road washed away into riverbed, communication completely cut off.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: ড্রেন উপচে নোংরা জল রাস্তায় দাঁড়িয়ে আছে {repeat} মশার উপদ্রব বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে {filler}।
templates.translation: Drains overflowing with dirty water on streets, severe mosquito nuisance.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: বিদ্যুৎ বিপর্যয় গত তিন দিন ধরে অব্যাহত {repeat} পানীয় জল সরবরাহ বন্ধ হয়ে গেছে {filler}।
templates.translation: Power failure continuing for three days, drinking water supply halted.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: ব্লক স্বাস্থ্য কেন্দ্রে জরুরি বিভাগে কোনো ডাক্তার নেই {repeat} {filler}।
templates.translation: No emergency doctor at block health centre.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: বানপানীৰ ফলত মথাউৰি ভাঙি পানী সোমাইছে {repeat} বিশুদ্ধ খোৱাপানীৰ তীব্ৰ নাটনি {filler}।
templates.translation: Embankment breached by floodwaters, severe shortage of clean drinking water.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: সংযোগী পথটো বানপানীত উটি গৈছে {repeat} যাতায়ত সম্পূৰ্ণৰূপে স্তব্ধ {filler}।
templates.translation: Connecting road washed away by floodwaters, traffic completely paralyzed.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: পানী শুকোৱাৰ পিছত চাৰিওফালে গেলা-পচা আৱৰ্জনা {repeat} মহামাৰীৰ আশংকা {filler}।
templates.translation: Decaying waste left behind after flood water receded, epidemic risk.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: তিনি দিন ধৰি গাঁৱত বিদ্যুৎ সংযোগ বিচ্ছিন্ন হৈ আছে {repeat} {filler}।
templates.translation: Electricity disconnected in village for three days.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: প্ৰাথমিক স্বাস্থ্য কেন্দ্ৰটো পানীত নিমজ্জিত {repeat} চিকিৎসা সেৱা ব্যাহত {filler}।
templates.translation: Primary health centre submerged in water, medical care disrupted.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: ನಮ್ಮ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಡಿಯುವ ನೀರಿನ ಕೊಳವೆಬಾವಿ ಬತ್ತಿಹೋಗಿದೆ {repeat} ನೀರಿನ ಟ್ಯಾಂಕರ್ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ {filler}.
templates.translation: Borewell dried up in our village, please send water tanker.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: ರಸ್ತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರಿ ಗುಂಡಿಗಳು ಬಿದ್ದಿದ್ದು ವಾಹನ ಸಂಚಾರ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: Huge potholes on road making vehicle transit impossible.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: ಚರಂಡಿ ನೀರು ರಸ್ತೆಗೆ ಹರಿದು ದುರ್ವಾಸನೆ ಬೀರುತ್ತಿದೆ {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: Drainage water overflowing onto road causing bad smell.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕಂಬ ಮುರಿದು ಬಿದ್ದಿದ್ದು ಪ್ರಾಣಾಪಾಯದ ಆತಂಕವಿದೆ {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: Electric pole broken and fallen, life hazard threat.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: ಸಮುದಾಯ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಕೇಂದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ತುರ್ತು ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ಲಭ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ {repeat} {filler}.
templates.translation: Emergency medical treatment unavailable at community health centre.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: ନଳକୂପ ଅଚଳ ହୋଇପଡ଼ିଥିବାରୁ ପାନୀୟ ଜଳ ପାଇଁ ଲୋକେ ଡହଳବିକଳ ହେଉଛନ୍ତି {repeat} {filler}।
templates.translation: Tube well defunct, villagers in extreme agony for drinking water.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: ପୋଲ ନଥିବାରୁ ବର୍ଷା ଦିନେ ଗାଁ ବାହ୍ୟଜଗତରୁ ବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ହୋଇପଡ଼ୁଛି {repeat} {filler}।
templates.translation: No bridge across nullah, village cut off during rainy season.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: ଗ୍ରାମରେ ଆବର୍ଜନା ପରିଚାଳନା ନଥିବାରୁ ରୋଗ ବ୍ୟାପୁଛି {repeat} {filler}।
templates.translation: No waste management in village leading to disease spread.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: ଲୋ ଭୋଲ୍ଟେଜ୍ ଯୋଗୁଁ ମୋଟର ଓ ଫ୍ୟାନ୍ ଚାଲୁନାହିଁ {repeat} {filler}।
templates.translation: Motors and fans not working due to extreme low voltage.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: ଉପସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରରେ ନର୍ସ କିମ୍ବା ଔଷଧ ନାହିଁ {repeat} {filler}।
templates.translation: Neither nurse nor medicines available at sub-health centre.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: మన గ్రామంలో నీరు సరిగా రాలేదు {repeat} ఐదు రోజులుగా ప్రజలు బాధితులవుతున్నారు {filler}.
templates.translation: No water supply in our village for five days, residents are suffering.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: ప్రధాన రోడ్డులో పెద్ద గుంతలు ఏర్పడ్డాయి {repeat} రెండు చ-wheel వాహనాలు పడిపోయின {filler}.
templates.translation: Large potholes on the main road, two-wheelers are falling regularly.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: ముత్రపైరు నీరు వీధిలో పాట్లుతూ ఉంది {repeat} దోమల ఉత్తరకాలం ఇబ్బంది కలిగిస్తోంది {filler}.
templates.translation: Drainage water overflowing into the street, mosquito menace is severe.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: ట్రాన్స్‌ఫార్మర్ పగిలిపోవడంతో మూడు రోజులుగా విద్యుత్ లేదు {repeat} పిల్లలు చదువుకోలేకపోతున్నారు {filler}.
templates.translation: Transformer failed, no electricity for three days, students unable to study.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: ప్రాథమిక ఆరోగ్య కేంద్రంలో వైద్యులు లేరు {repeat} గర్భిణి మహిళలు ఇబ్బంది పడుతున్నారు {filler}.
templates.translation: No doctor at the primary health centre, pregnant women are struggling.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: పాఠశాల పైకప్పు పగులిపోయింది {repeat} వర్షాకాలంలో ప్రమాదకరంగా ఉంది {filler}.
templates.translation: School roof has cracked, dangerous during the monsoon.
templates.action: School infrastructure repair drive

templates.text: రాత్రి వేళ దీపాలు పనిచేయడం లేదు {repeat} మహిళలు నడకకు భయపడుతున్నారు {filler}.
templates.translation: Streetlights are not working at night, women fear walking outside.
templates.action: Streetlight restoration and night patrol deployment

templates.text: ഞങ്ങളുടെ ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ വെള്ളം വരുന്നില്ല {repeat} അഞ്ച് ദിവസമായി ആളുകൾ കഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്നു {filler}.
templates.translation: No drinking water in our village for five days, people are struggling.
templates.action: Water supply restoration and pipeline repair

templates.text: പ്രധാന റോഡിലെ വലിയ കുഴിപ്പുകൾ വളരുന്നു {repeat} രണ്ടു ചക്രവാഹനങ്ങൾ വിപത്തിൽ പട്ടി {filler}.
templates.translation: Large potholes growing on the main road, two vehicles have already met with accidents.
templates.action: Road inspection and phased repair

templates.text: ഡ്രെയിൻ വെള്ളം റോഡിലേക്ക് ഒഴുകിയിരിക്കുന്നു {repeat} ദാമ്പത്തിന്റെ ഭയം വർദ്ധിക്കുന്നു {filler}.
templates.translation: Drain water is flowing onto the road, the mosquito threat is increasing.
templates.action: Sanitation, desilting and waste collection drive

templates.text: ട്രാൻസ്‌ഫോർമർ പൊട്ടിയതിനാൽ മൂന്ന് ദിവസം വൈദ്യുതിയില്ല {repeat} കുട്ടികൾ പഠിക്കാൻ കഴിയുന്നില്ല {filler}.
templates.translation: Transformer burnt down, no power for three days, children cannot study.
templates.action: Transformer repair and load-shedding audit

templates.text: പ്രാഥമിക ആരോഗ്യ കേന്ദ്രത്തിൽ ഡോക്ടർ ഇല്ല {repeat} ഗർഭിണികളും ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടുകളും കഷ്ടപ്പെടുന്നു {filler}.
templates.translation: No doctor at the primary health centre, pregnant women and elderly are suffering.
templates.action: Health staffing and essential equipment release

templates.text: വിദ്യാലയത്തിന്റെ മാത്രം ചുരന്നുപോയി {repeat} മഴയുമ്പോൾ അപாயകരം {filler}.
templates.translation: The school roof has cracked, dangerous when it rains.
templates.action: School infrastructure repair drive

templates.text: અમારી ગામમાં પાણી આવતું નથી {repeat} પાંચ દિવસથી લોકો ત્રૂટું છે {filler}.
